choice.basis: The dashboard uses a dual-axis format with no visible numeric tick labels on either the left (Rest of the world) or right (U.S.) vertical axes. While the blue 2020 mark is positioned higher on the page than the red 2020 mark, the 2018 data (U.S. 15875 vs. Rest of the world 13993) shows the U.S. mark plotted lower than the Rest of the world mark despite having a larger value. This confirms the vertical scales are not directly comparable for ranking. Without numeric ticks or 2020 point labels, the actual 2020 values cannot be determined from the chart, making it impossible to identify which region has the larger value.
